why_ai: Value is delivered in a walk-in store, where reps hand over and set up physical phones, but no licence protects the work and carriers are steering routine transactions to apps and closing doors.
why_clarity: Activations, attach rates and commissions are counted exactly on thousands of near-identical deals, though whether a deal sticks is known only months later.
why_digital: Customers and devices arrive in person at a local store and leave with a phone in hand; production scores a notch above general retail only because the activation itself is keyed into carrier portals at the counter.

why_ai: Running hundreds of carrier stores is mostly scorecard and staffing management that analytics increasingly automates; the store floor stays human.
why_clarity: Carrier scorecards define success in exact metrics every month, though definitions change and chargebacks settle late.
why_digital: POS, traffic and commission data are digital and analysed on screens, while the stores themselves serve local walk-in customers.

why_ai: Cash-paying prepaid customers rely on a nearby store and a familiar owner to activate and pay, which keeps demand for the counter.
why_clarity: Activations, bill payments and chargebacks are countable and repeat daily, but first-recharge outcomes arrive weeks later.
why_digital: Cash, devices and walk-in customers in neighbourhood stores; the brand portal is the only screen-native part.

why_ai: Matching statements to sales and netting clawbacks is rule-based screen work that software and language models can take over.
why_clarity: Each line is paid correctly or not under a written plan, and the same matching recurs every month.
why_digital: Statements and POS records in, reconciled ledgers and pay adjustments out, all on screens.

why_ai: Statement matching and dispute assembly are mechanical and directly automatable.
why_clarity: A short payment is objectively short against the plan, and dispute outcomes come back within weeks.
why_digital: Carrier files and POS data in, disputes filed through carrier portals.

why_ai: Pay calculations automate fully; the employer stays accountable under wage law for each deduction.
why_clarity: Each clawback follows a written plan and recurs every pay run, checkable against carrier files.
why_digital: Commission and payroll data in, pay statements out, entirely on screens.

why_ai: Store visits and investigations of rep misconduct need people with authority on site, though evidence capture automates.
why_clarity: Audit checklists are defined, but proving consent and spotting cramming involve judgement and late complaints.
why_digital: Transaction data and photos are digital, but audits and investigations happen in physical stores.

why_ai: Training content on plans and promotions is directly generated and delivered by software; in-store coaching is the remaining human part.
why_clarity: Plan changes recur monthly, but whether training reduced chargebacks is visible only months later.
why_digital: Plan documents in, lessons and answers delivered on phones and tablets to store staff.

why_ai: Neighbourhood shops trade on the owner's language, trust and cash handling for customers mainstream channels don't serve.
why_clarity: Activations and commissions are countable, but brand choice and spiff economics shift weekly and are judged by feel.
why_digital: Walk-in customers, cash and phones at a local counter, with several brand portals open on screen.

why_ai: Activation and porting are scripted steps across systems that automation and customer self-service can absorb.
why_clarity: Each activation succeeds or fails within minutes or a day, following the carrier's codified flow.
why_digital: Data entry and portals on screens, finished by a phone handed over in person to a local customer.

why_ai: Inspecting a physical device at the counter keeps a hands-on step, though vision models can grade it.
why_clarity: Programme grade definitions are explicit and every trade-in repeats, but the final grade arrives weeks later.
why_digital: Starts from a physical phone in hand; eligibility checks and credits are digital.

why_ai: Shoppers must physically visit stores, while scoring and reporting are screen work AI accelerates.
why_clarity: Shop questionnaires are standardised and repeated across thousands of visits with clear pass or fail items.
why_digital: Field observations become digital reports delivered remotely to carrier channel teams.

why_ai: Assortment and sell-through analysis is analytics AI tooling handles, with buyer relationships the durable part.
why_clarity: Launch assortments repeat each device cycle and sell-through is measurable within weeks, though taste plays a part.
why_digital: Sales data in, planograms and recommendations out, sold through account relationships.

why_ai: In-product analytics are automatable; the cross-store transaction data is what lasts.
why_clarity: Matching and reporting features compute the same metrics daily with immediate checks.
why_digital: Transaction data in, software features out, entirely digital.

why_ai: Scorecard and chargeback models are standard analytics; door valuations need judgement on carrier intentions.
why_clarity: Monthly projections are checked against the carrier's scorecard, but acquisitions resolve over years.
why_digital: Commission and store data in, internal models and deal cases out, all on screens.

why_ai: Comp-plan modelling and dealer analytics automate, while dealer negotiations and door decisions stay with people.
why_clarity: Plans and scorecards are defined monthly, though their effect on dealer behaviour shows up slowly.
why_digital: Channel data in, plans and dealer reports out, delivered digitally to dealers.

why_ai: Legal authority to investigate, fine and prosecute can't be handed to software, and account-takeover enforcement demand is rising.
why_clarity: Complaint handling follows procedure, but each case differs and outcomes take months or years.
why_digital: Complaints and records in, orders and cases out, with hearings and investigations in person.

why_ai: Payouts automate, but device distribution and dealer relationships keep a physical and personal layer.
why_clarity: Payout calculations repeat monthly against brand statements, with chargebacks settling weeks later.
why_digital: Statements and payouts are digital, while devices and SIMs are shipped to local dealers recruited in person.

why_ai: Clerical reconciliation on client files is the work software substitutes most directly.
why_clarity: Each line matches or doesn't, under rules, every month.
why_digital: Client files in, reconciliation reports out, delivered remotely, often from offshore.

why_ai: Deals rest on the adviser's relationships with dealers, carriers and buyers, and each transaction is negotiated.
why_clarity: Every deal is bespoke and its success is judged years later.
why_digital: Financials are analysed on screens, but mandates are won and closed through personal relationships.

why_ai: Advocacy and member trust depend on standing with dealers and legislators, which AI doesn't substitute.
why_clarity: Member programmes repeat, but advocacy outcomes are slow and contested.
why_digital: Member services run online, with influence exercised through meetings and testimony.

why_ai: Collection and returns automate, but statutory authority to assess and audit stays with officials.
why_clarity: Rates and filing rules are statutory, and every return is checked against them.
why_digital: Returns and payments filed online; audits sometimes in person within the state.
